messages:
Maya: Ok team — launching the benchmark + webinar push next week. I sketched a small schedule and need final assets + routing confirmed. High level: 1) Benchmark announcement (LinkedIn long post + image) 2) X thread tease + CTAs to webinar page 3) Paid push on LinkedIn for webinar signups. Can we lock assets by EOD tomorrow?

AJ (growth): timeline looks good. For paid, recommend 48h ramp before webinar. budget ask: $2k/day for 3 days? Target: product managers + ML infra leads.

Sam (design): I can do hero image + 1:1 post crop + X thread image. Do we need a short promo video (15s)?

Maya: Yes, a 15s video would be great but only if it won't block schedules. Priorities: hero image (1200x627), X thread header (1600x900), and one carousel slide for LinkedIn detail. Video optional.

Dipa (content): I'll draft three variants for the LinkedIn post (longform narrative, data-led snapshot, and executive quote). Also will draft the 6-tweet X thread and 1-liner CTAs for paid ads. Will post drafts in this thread by noon.

Rory (demand-gen): Lead routing — we should push webinar signups into SFDC with campaign = "benchmark_launch_mar2026" and owner assignment to the inbound queue, then round-robin to AE team for follow-up within 24h. Also want custom UTM params: utm_source=linkedin/x, utm_campaign=benchmark_launch_mar2026, utm_medium=social.

Ella (ops): Quick note on scheduling windows: LinkedIn performs best Wed/Thu 9-11am PT. X has highest engagement Tue/Thu 12-1pm PT. If webinar is Thurs 3pm PT, suggested schedule: LinkedIn announcement Wed 9am PT, X thread Thu 12pm PT with reminder tweet 24h before.

Maya: Proposed copy flow: LinkedIn long post (announce + data snapshot + CTA to webinar), X thread (build suspense -> share key stat -> CTA), Paid creatives link to webinar landing with gated content. Also want a small follow-up DM/campaign to people who engage (likes/RTs) within 48h — can the Growth team handle that?

AJ (growth): We can run an engagement follow-up drip via Salesloft for people who click through and match ICP. For likes/RTs we can create a saved audience for the paid campaign and retarget. Not ideal to manually DM everyone.

Sam (design): Dipa — what's the main stat we'd like to highlight for the visual? I can make the stat pop.

Dipa (content): Main stat = "25-40% latency reduction" from our benchmark runs on latest runtime. Secondary stat: median cost-per-token savings ~2.3x. I'll put the exact numbers in the copy doc.

Maya: Cool. Also: need final UTM'd links for ads and the webinar confirmation email copy (so registrants get the right tracking). Rory can you confirm UTM + SFDC fields?

Rory (demand-gen): Confirmed. SFDC fields: Campaign = benchmark_launch_mar2026, LeadSource = Social, SubSource = LinkedIn/X (use picklist mapping). UTM string below — please use as-is:

`?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=benchmark_launch_mar2026&utm_content=post`

Ella (ops): SchedulerBot — can you queue the LinkedIn post for 2026-03-11 09:00:00 PT and X thread for 2026-03-12 12:00:00 PT (UTC offsets accounted for)?

SchedulerBot: Scheduled: LinkedIn post to buffer_queue at 2026-03-11T16:00:00Z. X thread scheduled at 2026-03-12T19:00:00Z.

Sam (design): Uploading hero image v1 to drive: https://drive.company/hero-benchmark-v1.png — feedback welcome.

Dipa (content): Draft copy posted here: https://docs.company/benchmark-linkedin-draft — variant B is my pick.

Maya: Quick ask on tone — want it data-forward but approachable. No heavy product jargon in social copy. Also include an executive quote from Noah in the LinkedIn post (short).

AJ (growth): Paid targeting suggestion: lookalike of existing Redwood customers, plus job titles: Platform Engineer, ML Engineer, CTO, Head of Infra. Geos: US + UK. We'll set conversion pixel to webinar-thanks page.

Rory (demand-gen): Also set callee mapping so MQLs from webinar are auto-tagged for SDR follow-up. Post-webinar nurture: 1 day -> recording + short snippet, 3 days -> deeper blog post, 7 days -> product trial CTA.

Ella (ops): One ops snag: LinkedIn paid campaign needs a company page billing owner. Maya, do we have that on file?

Maya: Yes, billing on file is the marketing card. I'll share access in admin console.

Sam (design): Small nit: hero image text needs +20px top margin for mobile. Will upload v2 in 30m.

Dipa (content): Posted the X thread here. Tweaked the CTA to be more urgent: "Save your spot — space limited."

AJ (growth): TL;DR approvals: content (Dipa) ✅, design (Sam) pending v2, paid budget approved (Rory) ✅, scheduling set (SchedulerBot) ✅. Maya, do you want a pinned Slack reminder 24h before each post?

Maya: Yes please. Pin a reminder for Wed 8:45am PT (LinkedIn) and Thu 11:45am PT (X). Also follow-up plan: inbox routing rule — if registrant is enterprise email domain, tag as priority.

Rory (demand-gen): Will add domain rules to the SFDC mapping.

Maya: Thanks all — final checklist: Sam deliver v2 image by 12pm tomorrow, Dipa finalize copy by noon, Rory confirm paid audience + UTMs, Ella confirm scheduling + billing page. If all green I'll push the assets to the social queue. :thumbsup:

Sam (design): On it. :thumbsup:

Dipa (content): Will finish at 11:30.

Rory (demand-gen): Budget scheduled and audience created.

Ella (ops): SchedulerBot will send reminders as requested.

Maya: Great. If anyone sees something missing call it out now. Otherwise will mark this thread as the single source for launch Qs.

AJ (growth): One final thought — consider a short reply thread after webinar with a TL;DR thread on X with the recording link, pinned on the profile for 72h.

Maya: Good idea. Add to post-webinar plan.

SchedulerBot: Reminder: task check — Sam: image v2 due 1775065630. Dipa: copy due 1775047200.

Maya: Thanks everyone, closing here.
